data.description: The Birthday Reminder Banner use case helps you collect the birthdays of one or two friends via a simple banner. Once their birthdays are approaching, you’ll receive an email reminder, ensuring you never miss such an important occasion.
data.name: Birthday Reminder Banner

template.callout: "This automated solution keeps you informed and prepared to celebrate your friends' special days. Stay connected and make every birthday memorable!"

fulfillments.description: Open the campaign and edit the banner to fit your brand and messaging. Launch the campaign in just a few clicks with this ready-made template developed by our e-commerce experts. Note that you can fill in up to five gift categories, but you are free to leave any category blank if you have fewer than five.
fulfillments.headline: Banner

fulfillments.description: Open the segmentation and edit each segment with the category names you used as gift category options in the birthday reminder banners, ensuring the order matches (e.g., category 1 corresponds to option 1). Do not change the segment names. If you have fewer than five categories, you may delete the extra segments, but this is optional.
fulfillments.headline: Customer Segmentation - Friend 1
